name: Do I need a permit for a tub-to-shower conversion in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a tub-to-shower conversion in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Do not assume that every tub-to-shower conversion is permit-free. The City of San Diego states that some bathroom remodels without structural changes and without added plumbing fixtures may use a no-plan permit path, while plumbing, electrical, mechanical, or fixture changes can affect permit requirements. Other jurisdictions in San Diego County may use different procedures.

Key factors:
- Identify the property’s actual city or unincorporated jurisdiction.
- List drain, valve, supply, electrical, fan, framing, and wall changes.
- Ask who will prepare and coordinate permit applications.
- Keep inspection requirements in the project schedule.

Elite Remodeling & Design describes a process that can include permit coordination and final inspection. Ask for written confirmation of the expected permit path before demolition begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Possibly. The City of San Diego has a no-plan path for some bathroom remodels, but plumbing, electrical, mechanical, structural, or fixture changes can affect requirements. Confirm the property jurisdiction and permit scope before work starts.
